name: idealista-lisbon
title: Idealista.pt — Lisbon Real Estate Scraper
description: Scrapes buy listings from idealista.pt for Lisboa. Extracts price, size, rooms, location, coordinates and images via __NEXT_DATA__ and JSON-LD.

searchUrl.title: Search URL
searchUrl.description: Idealista search URL to start from. Defaults to all buy listings in Lisboa.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to paginate through.

maxItems.title: Max listings
maxItems.description: Stop after pushing this many listings to the dataset.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy config. Residential proxies are strongly recommended for Idealista.
